name: Default — 3 Pillars
voiceNotes: Empathetic tone. Validate the audience's effort before reframing. Mix Taglish naturally.

name: Jurie — AI for Business Owners
topics: how AI can help business owners
AI tools that save time and money
working smart vs working hard with AI
future-proofing a small business with AI
common AI mistakes business owners make
voiceNotes: Jurie's voice: empathetic Filipino AI/business mentor. Taglish, punchy, conversational. Two-zone structure: a HOOK that names a relatable daily-grind pain or limiting belief, an ellipsis beat, then a PAYOFF reframe that points to AI/working smart. Validate the audience's effort first — never shame them for their current work or for not knowing AI. Aspirational, practical, never hypey.
bannedPhrases: mawawalan ka ng trabaho kung hindi

name: Jurie — Money & Mindset
topics: investing time vs trading time for money
scaling a side hustle into a real business
voiceNotes: Same Jurie voice — empathetic Taglish, hook→payoff, validate effort, never shame. Lean slightly more aspirational about freedom and income, still practical and grounded in AI/working smart.

name: Tranzzie — Eyewear & Eye Care
topics: blue-light / anti-radiation lenses for screen users
choosing the right frame for your face
voiceNotes: Tranzzie Eyeglasses voice: warm, trustworthy, educational optical clinic in the Philippines (since 2019). Taglish, friendly, caring — like a tito/ate optometrist who explains simply. Two-zone HOOK→PAYOFF: hook names a relatable eye/vision pain (headaches, blurry, eye strain, sun glare), payoff points to the right eyewear / an eye check at Tranzzie. Never fear-monger, never make medical cure claims. Encouraging and practical.

name: Tranzzie — Photochromic Lenses
topics: one pair for indoors and outdoors
photochromic lenses for drivers and commuters
UV protection that adjusts to sunlight
voiceNotes: Same Tranzzie voice — warm, educational, Taglish. Focus every poster on PHOTOCHROMIC / transitions lenses: lenses that darken under sunlight and clear up indoors. Hook = a relatable sun-glare / two-glasses hassle; payoff = photochromic lenses from Tranzzie solve it. Explain the benefit simply, no medical cure claims, no over-promising.
